facts.fact: Tech Africa News says Nigeria introduced the National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode System on 1 October 2026, led by NIPOST with Milsat Technologies, and that it assigns an 11-character code to every addressable building.

Tech Africa News says NDAPS assigns a code to every addressable building in the country and its database holds structures across the entire country, mapped from satellite imagery and field verification.

systems.platform: Milsat Technologies satellite basemaps and GIS; public lookups resolve to AWS
